newsitem.title: USA: Host Marriott gets $500 mln revolving line.
newsitem.headline: Host Marriott gets $500 mln revolving line.

text.p: Host Marriott Corp on Monday announced a new $500 million revolving credit line to be used for acquisitions and general corporate purposes.
Host Marriott had previously maintained a line of credit with Marriott International Inc. That line of credit has been terminated, Host said.
"With pricing at LIBOR plus 170 basis points, the cost of this facility is currently well below our average cost of debt," said Host chief financial officer Robert Parsons Jr.
The credit facility is led by Bankers Trust Co, with Wells Fargo Bank, The Bank of Nova Scotia and Credit Lyonnais acting as co-agents.
The credit line is structured as a three-year revolving credit facility and a four-year term loan secured by a group of hotel properties and the assets which are purchased using the facility.
Under the terms of the new facility, the company may use up to $100 million for general corporate purposes.

Host Marriott is a lodging real estate company which currently owns or holds controlling interests in 86 upscale and luxury full-service hotel properties operated primarily under the Marriott and Ritz-Carlton brand names.
The company also serves as general partner and holds minority interests in various unconsolidated partnerships that own 250 lodging properties, 30 of which are full service hotels.
